name: A 290-Concept Antipodal-Tip Nonrepair
definition: Add $c=167$ to the normalized 289-concept rooted factor $B$. Its acquired support is $P=\{0,1,6,8\}$, with bitmask $323$, and the antipode of $c$ in its completed four-cube is the old word $484$.
parameters: The extension $H$ has $290$ concepts, dimension $12$, and VC dimension $4$.
properties: The completed cube has exactly two vertices without exterior neighbours: $167$ and $484$. Thus $484$ becomes an old nonroot corner, and the corners of $H$ are exactly $0,167,484$. Deleting either nonroot corner leaves zero as the only corner, so $(H,0)$ remains a rooted factor. Exposing an old antipodal corner is insufficient to restore the endpoint.
